recipe.criteria: Push-up with right hand slightly forward and left hand slightly back. Fixed staggered palms and toes, straight trunk, 3.5 seconds down, 1 second bottom pause, 3.5 seconds up. One hand arrangement demonstrated; change sides between sets.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
